# pugixml 1.16

Source: https://github.com/zeux/pugixml
Release asset: https://github.com/zeux/pugixml/releases/download/v1.16/pugixml-1.16.tar.gz
(SHA-256 `4cee1ca4aad395170f4c7a07824f3bdd41f28316c6e1e1090a1425b278ec0b4b`)
License: MIT (see `LICENSE.md`)

`pugixml.cpp`, `pugixml.hpp`, and `pugiconfig.hpp` are copied unchanged from
the release's `src/` folder. LeanDoc compiles them into `leandoc_core` with
`PUGIXML_NO_EXCEPTIONS` and `PUGIXML_NO_XPATH`.
